jobs.description:
**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the mergers with Axioma and Domos, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**Our Market Units are where SimCorp meets its clients – and the commercial engine behind them is what turns strategy into growth. As Head of Global Commercial, you will lead the global commercial organisation that powers our front-line Market Unit teams, including Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and Marketing.

Reporting to Oliver Johnson, Chief Revenue Officer, and working as a peer to our regional Managing Directors, you will lead a commercial transformation with a clear top-line focus: making our Market Units more effective, more productive and better equipped to win. The role is based in EMEA – in London, Copenhagen or Frankfurt.

Success in this role means Market Units that spend more of their time with clients, a commercial organisation where AI and data are part of how every team works, and a commercial model that scales with SimCorp’s growth.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Commercial transformation: Define and lead a transformation agenda that makes SimCorp’s Market Units across all regions more efficient, scalable and growth-oriented

• Commercial organisation: Lead and develop Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and Marketing, ensuring each function directly supports front-line performance

• Top-line growth: Improve pipeline generation, sales productivity, win rates and deal velocity across the Market Units

• Operating model: Review and optimise the commercial team set-up and operating model, so people, resources and investment are focused on the highest-impact growth opportunities

• AI and data: Embed AI, automation and data-driven insight into commercial processes – from forecasting and territory planning to enablement and marketing execution

• Stakeholder partnership: Work closely with the Chief Revenue Officer, partner with regional Managing Directors and Market Unit leaders, and establish a commercial cadence and KPIs that give leadership clear transparency on performance

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest:

• Experience leading a commercial team transformation end-to-end, with measurable improvements in productivity and growth

• Significant experience driving commercial performance and value creation; scaled experience in Financial Services, Private Equity or Software

• Deep knowledge of financial services and the investment management software market, including the buy-side client landscape, market dynamics and competitors

• Senior leadership of commercial functions such as Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and/or Marketing, across multiple regions and cultures

• An AI-native mindset, with hands-on experience applying AI, automation and modern go-to-market tooling to commercial teams

• Leadership that builds and inspires high-performing teams, makes difficult decisions with clarity and empathy, and influences senior stakeholders in a matrix organisation

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact Michael Paterson, Talent Acquisition Partner, at MLPN@SimCorp.com . If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Enterprise Sales Development Representative — Italian Speaking, South Pod EMEAHelp us create qualified enterprise pipeline that protects the world's factory floors

Start date: January 1, 2027

At Secomea, our Sales Development team plays a critical role in creating and developing new business opportunities across manufacturers, machine builders and industrial organizations.

As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative for our South Pod, with a focus on Italy, you'll work closely with Territory Managers and the wider commercial team to identify the right accounts, engage relevant stakeholders and develop opportunities into qualified enterprise pipeline.

Your primary focus will be supporting our growth across Italy and the Southern European markets.

This is not simply an appointment-setting role. We want our SDRs to understand the businesses they target, recognize relevant market and customer signals, and have credible conversations with prospects.

You'll use modern sales technology and AI to make research, preparation and personalization more effective—giving you more time to focus on developing business and engaging customers.

What you'll do

• 
Generate qualified pipeline across named enterprise accounts within the Southern Europe territory

• 
Research and prioritize target accounts based on fit, business signals and relevant triggers

• 
Develop outbound, inbound and partner-sourced opportunities

• 
Engage prospects through calls, email, LinkedIn and other relevant channels

• 
Build relationships across multiple stakeholders, including OT, Security, Operations, IT and business leaders

• 
Run initial discovery to understand business challenges, priorities, timing and potential opportunities

• 
Work strategically with Territory Managers on target accounts and territory priorities

• 
Collaborate with Partner Managers, Marketing and Pre-Sales to develop opportunities

• 
Create high-quality Sales Accepted Opportunities and ensure a strong handover to the Territory Manager

• 
Use AI and sales technology to support account research, preparation and relevant outreach

• 
Maintain accurate account, activity and opportunity information in Salesforce

What we're looking for

Commercial curiosity

You're interested in understanding how companies operate, what challenges they're facing and where there may be an opportunity to create value.

You don't just ask, "Who can I book a meeting with?" You want to understand why this company, why this person and why now.

Strong communication

You're comfortable starting conversations with new people, whether that's over the phone, email, LinkedIn or in a meeting.

You can communicate clearly, ask good questions and adapt your approach depending on who you're speaking with.

Fluent, professional-level Italian and English, both written and spoken, is required for this role, as you'll be prospecting, conducting discovery and communicating with senior stakeholders across the Italy and Southern European markets.

Dutch language skills are a strong advantage, but not required.

Account-based thinking

You understand—or want to learn—how enterprise sales differs from high-volume prospecting.

You're comfortable researching accounts, identifying multiple relevant stakeholders and developing different ways into an organization rather than relying on a single contact.

Business acumen

You're interested in learning about manufacturing, industrial operations and cybersecurity and can connect technology to business outcomes such as uptime, productivity, service efficiency, risk and compliance.

AI & digital fluency

You're comfortable using modern technology to work smarter.

Experience with generative AI, sales intelligence or prospecting tools is an advantage, but you don't need to be an AI expert. What's more important is curiosity, good judgment and the willingness to learn how these tools can improve your research and sales effectiveness.

Drive and discipline

You're proactive, resilient and comfortable taking ownership of your territory and pipeline.

At the same time, you understand that enterprise sales requires discipline: following up, keeping CRM data accurate, documenting what you've learned and consistently delivering on commitments.

How we measure success

Success in this role is about creating quality pipeline—not simply generating activity.

You'll be measured on areas including:

• 
Qualified opportunities created

• 
Pipeline generated

• 
Qualified meetings booked and held

• 
Quality and conversion of opportunities

• 
Development of target enterprise accounts

• 
Collaboration with Territory Managers and partners

• 
Consistent use of our sales processes and tools

What success looks like at Secomea

Our strongest Enterprise SDRs are account-first, curious and commercially minded.

They research before they reach out. They look for real reasons to engage. They build relationships across an organization rather than relying on one contact. They use technology intelligently, but know that great conversations and human judgment ultimately create opportunities.

Most importantly, they see themselves as business developers—not appointment setters.

If you're excited about developing your enterprise sales career while working at the intersection of industrial technology, cybersecurity and modern sales, we'd like to hear from you.

Do you want to help deliver overhead transmission line projects? Can you combine electrical expertise with technical project leadership? And do you have experience establishing high-voltage installations? Then join us as our new Technical Lead!

Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

As our project portfolio grows, so does the need for Technical Leads. We are looking for a consultant to take on technical project management tasks in the construction of overhead transmission lines. You will become part of a large community of Electrical Specialists in COWI, in the discipline Power Transmission and Distribution. In this role, travel to sites in Denmark in connection with the projects will be required.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Carry out detailed design, including tower locations, tower types, insulator fittings, conductor sizing, etc. by use of standard software applications.

• Participating in external meetings with external stakeholders such as plot owners, municipalities, road authorities, etc.

• Specify and procure components and materials through framework agreements or in collaboration with the procurement team, and specify requirements for contractor service tenders, including tender evaluation, negotiations together with the procurement team.

• Manage contact with landowners and contribute to substation projects to ensure the overhead lines can connect to the substation bays.

• Drive project delivery, facilitate on-site construction meetings, and handle site testing, quality assurance documentation and handover.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways, but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve. You are proactive in your approach to tasks, collaborative and solution-oriented, and able to manage several tasks at the same time.

On top of that, you will have:

• A structural or electrical engineering or technical background, for example as an engineer, electrical installer (installatør) or maskinmester.

• Experience establishing high-voltage installations.

• Experience driving projects within your area of expertise.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Head of Discipline Pia Alrøe atPIAL@COWI.com.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

**Minimum qualifications:

**

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 1 year of experience in program or project management.

• Experience in maintenance planning and scheduling.

• Experience working with a CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System).

**Preferred qualifications:

**

• Possession of a Bachelor's in Arts /Science/ Engineering degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Extensive experience in critical facilities management or operations management, encompassing facility, operations, technical, and team leadership.

• Demonstrated experience as a Facilities/Operations Manager or Chief Engineer within a critical facility.

• Proven electrical or mechanical experience is necessary.

SYBO is part of the Miniclip family and known for the widely popular game, Subway Surfers - the most downloaded mobile game in the world, with over four and a half billion downloads. Located in the heart of Copenhagen, we aim to create playful moments that inspire our fans to care.

We’re looking for a talented UI Artist to work with one of the biggest mobile games IP in the world: Subway Surfers.

Art has always been a northstar at SYBO, and we take great part in creating polished and high quality art that brings storytelling to life. Here you’ll join a seasoned group of artists all working closely together to make our games feel as good as it looks! We have a highly collaborative, feedback-friendly space where ideas bounce fast and bold, and where UI design really drives the player experience.

You’ll have the rare chance to shape UI at scale on either of our games, depending on which team you’ll be joining. If you’re the kind of artist who loves iterating, thrives on polish, and gets a kick out of elevating your team as much as your pixels - you’ll fit right in.

If above sounds interesting, and working with an IP that reaches hundreds of millions of players a month, read on!

**Responsibilities

**

• Create polished, lively UI art that enhances the established art direction and stays true to the Subway Surfers brand.

• Design intuitive and engaging UI screens, assets, and interactions for new and existing game features.

• Develop and present UI concepts and interactive prototypes that clearly communicate the intended look, feel, and player experience.

• Collaborate closely with the art, design and engineering to bring player-centric features from concept to implementation

• Contribute to UX work through wireframes, user flows and prototypes

• Create and maintain UI design systems, style guides, and documentation to support consistency and scalability across screens and features.

• Work directly with the Unity engine on pixel-perfect UI Implementation and asset performance optimization

Life at SYBO

In your first month, you’ll dive into our tools, pipelines, and the people behind them. You’ll get to know the direction of the game, the feel of the team, and slowly start contributing to UI work and discussions.

Within 3 months, you’re now owning key UI assignments. You collaborate closely with game design, and your work is directly shaping and refining the player journey.

By 12 months, you’ve become a core part of the team’s creative engine - raising the bar for UI art and design, pushing for polish, and helping define what great looks like at SYBO. Maybe even beyond your own game team.

**Requirements

**

• A strong portfolio demonstrating solid UI work for games, with clear examples of creating intuitive, polished, and engaging UIs.

• Ability to follow - and build on - an established art direction

• Some experience creating wireframes, user flows and mockups - we don’t expect you to be a UX expert, but we expect you to be the UI expert, and have a solid grasp of how that fits into UX.

• Skilled at designing, rendering - and possibly animating - high-quality UI elements that bring personality and clarity to the player experience.

• Proficiency with modern UI/UX and prototyping tools, particularly Figma.

• Experience working with Unity or similar engines, and a solid understanding of UI implementation

Bonus Points

• Experience working on large-scale live service mobile games.

**About SYBO

**We're SYBO, the mobile games studio behind the legendary Subway Surfers, with over 4 billion downloads worldwide! Join our team in the heart of Copenhagen, where creativity flourishes in our new, state-of-the-art studio.

If you join us, you'll have the opportunity to dive into exciting and creative projects alongside a diverse group of like-minded colleagues from over 40 countries across the globe.

We truly believe you perform your best, when you have the equipment you need - and our IT team is always on hand to ensure you have access to the latest tools and gear, enabling you to be at your best - even remotely with a home-office budget!

We also pride ourselves in taking care of your well-being, offering a delicious lunch buffet, a variety of healthy snacks, and regular social events to keep the energy flowing.

Not in Copenhagen? Not a problem! We have in-house relocation specialists who will help you relocate, and feel right at home in Copenhagen and at SYBO!

SYBO is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants, regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Phanofi is a DTU spin-out building the next generation of optical communication infrastructure. We design integrated photonic interconnect chips that dramatically reduce power consumption and increase data throughput for AI datacenters, quantum computing, and space applications. As a diverse team of 15 people, we are at an exciting inflection point, and we are looking for a senior leader to drive our commercial growth.

As Head of Business Development, you will own Phanofi's commercial trajectory. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will define and execute the go-to-market strategy, forge high-value industry partnerships, lead the company's funding and grant initiatives, and represent Phanofi on the global stage. This is a senior, highly visible role with the opportunity, and expectation, to build the business development function from the ground up.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Strategy & Commercial Leadership: Define and execute Phanofi’s business development strategy, establish commercial goals and KPIs, and drive market expansion across AI datacenters, quantum computing, and space sectors.

• Industry Relationships & Partnerships: Build and maintain strategic relationships with key stakeholders across the data communications, semiconductor, and photonics industries, while leading partnership discussions and negotiations.

• Market Intelligence & Business Insights: Conduct market research, monitor industry trends and competitive developments, and translate technical innovations into compelling business opportunities and commercial strategies.

• Brand Representation & External Communications: Represent Phanofi at industry conferences, trade shows, and networking events, while supporting thought leadership, public relations, and external communications activities.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• Experience: You bring a minimum of 5 years of experience in business development, or commercial leadership within the photonics, semiconductor, deep-tech, or related technology industries. You have a proven track record of securing strategic partnerships, commercial agreements, or major funding opportunities.

• Technical Background: You have a strong engineering or scientific background, preferably in photonics, integrated optics, electronics, communications, or a related field, enabling you to engage confidently with technical teams and customers.

• Education: A master’s degree in Engineering, Physics, or a related discipline is preferred. An MBA combined with a technical degree is considered an advantage.

• Skills: You possess strong business development, partnership management, negotiation, and market analysis skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling business value propositions.

• Leadership & Soft Skills: You are a strategic and entrepreneurial leader who can influence cross-functional teams, communicate effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders, and thrive in a fast-paced deep-tech startup environment. Fluency in English is required; Danish or other European languages are considered a plus.

**The Perks

**We care about your long-term growth and well-being. We offer performance-based stock options, healthcare insurance, professional development support, and a positive culture with free snacks. You will also enjoy standard Danish benefits, including 5 weeks of paid holiday and maternity/paternity leave.

**How To Apply

**If you are interested in joining us on our entrepreneurial journey, we encourage you to submit your CV and a cover letter. We look forward to hearing from you!

Phanofi is committed to providing a workplace where equal opportunity and non-discrimination are fundamental principles. In accordance with Danish law and the European Union’s legal framework, Phanofi ensures that all employment decisions, including recruitment, hiring, pay, promotion, training, and termination, are made without regard to gender, race, color, religion or belief, political affiliation, sexual orientation, age, disability, or national, social, or ethnic origin.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:

**ELSE Cluster Manager North Europe

__

**Your Role And Responsibilities

**In this role you will work as a power engineer on a range of exciting projects for global clients in a rewarding team environment, developing technical and solution development skills to develop into an industry-recognized consulting engineer. The position would suit a practical and motivated individual who wishes to work in a progressive, innovative electrical consultancy.

We are seeking experienced Power Systems Engineers who are looking to deepen their technical knowledge and contribute to complex engineering projects for global clients. This role is ideal for a practical, resourceful, and technically driven engineer who wants to grow into an industry-recognized consulting specialist within a progressive and innovative electrical consultancy environment.

The work model for the role is: #hybrid,

Motivated by continued business growth and increasing customer demand, we are expanding our team and recruiting multiple professionals for this role across the listed countries.

You will be mainly accountable for:

• Providing technical input and leadership on a variety of complex projects.

• Working closely with clients to understand their technical and business requirements and translating them into practical engineering solutions.

• Ensuring project outputs meet client expectations, quality standards, timeframes, and budget requirements.

• Conducting in-depth power systems analysis using widely used methodologies and software tools.

• Preparing detailed technical and non-technical reports, presenting clear recommendations and actionable insights.

• Attending client meetings remotely, building trusted relationships and managing expectations through effective communication and responsiveness.

• Tracking and reporting on project performance and client satisfaction.

• Mentoring, coaching and developing more junior engineers. Online training to be delivered where applicable.

**Typical projects include:

**

• Power system studies include load flow, short circuit, protection coordination and system resilience assessments.

• Electrical safety and power quality studies, including arc flash, harmonics and earthing assessments.

• Grid connection and renewable energy integration projects, covering stability, harmonics and compliance analyses.

• Reliability assessments and failure investigations for critical electrical infrastructure.

• Software-based engineering solutions and emerging technology evaluations.

• Supporting wind energy projects from design through installation and commissioning.

**Qualifications For The Role

**

• You are highly skilled in power system studies, including short circuit, protection coordination and arc flash analysis, and enjoy working on complex electrical infrastructure projects.

• You have 3+ years of experience in power systems engineering, applying technical skills to deliver reliable, safe and efficient electrical solutions.

• You possess advanced knowledge of widely used power system analysis tools such as SKM, EasyPower, ETAP or similar.

• You have solid experience in protection system design, settings development and coordination studies, with exposure to transformer and bus differential protection, REF and directional protection schemes.

• You have experience performing electrical calculations and developing designs in accordance with relevant IEC standards.

• Knowledge of power quality, harmonics and renewable energy integration studies.

• You are interested in solving technical challenges, collaborating with clients and stakeholders, and continuously expanding your knowledge.

• Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.

• You are comfortable communicating in English and can clearly present technical concepts to a wide range of audiences

**Compensation Package

**This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage.

The offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

This opportunity is open to candidates in one or more countries covered by the European Pay Transparency Directive. The final work location will depend on the selected candidate. As pay may vary by location, compensation details will be shared with candidates who progress to the first interview stage.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Are you skilled at turning financial information into a clear performance story? Can you move confidently from the detail behind the numbers to the insights that matter most? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment with senior stakeholder exposure?

The Group FP&A function owns and steers the financial performance of Pandora. The function plays a vital role in defining and enforcing the global performance management framework and policies across Global Finance and within the business – including being the driver of planning, budgeting and forecasting, defining KPIs and management reporting to the CFO and CEO. The function is therefore key to Pandora’s ability to provide the right guidance on expected future performance to the capital markets.

As Senior Manager, FP&A Reporting, you will play a key role in Pandora’s Group performance reporting, translating financial results and underlying business drivers into clear, decision-relevant insights for the CFO and CEO.

You will play a key role in the end-to-end performance reporting cycle, turning performance trends and underlying drivers into sharp insights, recommendations and actions. Working closely with Group Reporting & Accounting, Group Commercial Finance and stakeholders across Pandora, you will combine strong financial foundations with sound business judgement to turn complexity into clarity.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Own and continuously develop Pandora’s end-to-end Group performance reporting, including clear and decision-relevant commentary.

• 
Lead the preparation of the monthly and quarterly Group Business Performance Reviews and closing reviews delivering a high-quality reporting pack that clearly highlights key results, business drivers, risks and opportunities.

• 
Prepare executive and Board reporting, translating financial information into concise, actionable insights.

• 
Coordinate FP&A activities related to monthly, quarterly and annual closing in close partnership with Group Reporting & Accounting and other Finance teams.

• 
Analyze performance against budget, forecast and prior periods, including key drivers across revenue, gross margin, costs and cash flow.

• 
Play a key role in the governance and reporting of like-for-like performance, including system logic and definitions, ensuring LFL is consistently applied as a key performance measure.

• 
Serve as the centre of excellence for Group reporting methodology and the management reporting package, ensuring one set of numbers

• 
Partner with our Global Cost Transformation office on reporting and follow-up of initiatives and financial benefits.

• 
Continuously improve the structure, content and quality of Group performance reporting and commentary, driving simplification, standardization and automation across reporting processes and ways of working.

What We’re Looking For

You are a business-minded finance professional with a strong technical foundations and the ability to turn detailed analysis into a compelling executive-level performance story.

What You Bring

• 
Relevant experience from a similar role within Group Finance, FP&A or controlling in a larger international organization.

• 
A robust accounting foundation and a solid understanding of the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow, including working capital.

• 
Experience with monthly closing, Group consolidation, management reporting and performance-review processes.

• 
Proven ability to translate financial results into clear, concise insights for CFO and/or Board-level audiences.

• 
Sound business acumen and judgement, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and focus on what matters most.

• 
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels.

• 
A proactive mindset, anticipating needs and raising issues and opportunities early rather than simply reacting to requests.

• 
A track record of improving, simplifying or automating finance and reporting processes, supported by advanced systems, Excel and PowerPoint skills.

• 
Comfort working in a complex international environment with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

Additional information

• Career Band 4A

Did we get your attention?

If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible.

You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Recognised by the Financial Times as one of Europe’s Best Workplaces and ranked #1 among Danish companies, Pandora is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that reflecting the diversity of society in how we engage with our customers is essential to fulfilling our purpose: to give a voice to people’s loves. We are dedicated to nurturing a culture where everyone feels respected, valued.

Help us build the future of workforce orchestration

Worklinq is a leading provider of Workforce Management solutions, with our software being used by more than 300,000 employees across some of Europe’s most well-known Enterprises. We are currently looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer to join our dedicated, international DevOps team. As a DevOps Engineer you will play a critical role in building, maintaining, and scaling our modern cloud setup, helping us take our platform and out processes to the next level.

What you bring

We are looking for a pragmatic, and solution-oriented team player with an agile "can-do" attitude and enterprise-grade experience. You will become part of a highly skilled team valuing collaboration, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Strongly preferred qualifications:

• Solid experience with Kubernetes management, security and optimization

• Infrastructure as code using Terraform

• Microsoft Azure platform and Azure DevOps

• Solid Git knowledge, ideally with experience in the GitHub ecosystem

What we offer

We collaborate closely across geographies and teams, and value diversity in culture and mindset. Ready to make an impact?

Hurry up and submit your application. We look forward to hearing from you.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**SimCorp is developing a new game changing Software-as-a-Service solution for Performance Measurement and Attribution, which will allow Investment Managers to interact with, and analyze their investments in a modern web application. It is connected to a high-performance computing calculation engine in the back-end, thus combining more than 50 years of industry-leading experience of SimCorp with a modern user experience and cloud computing, enabling users to do in minutes what used to take hours.

We welcome applications from both early‑career and mid‑career software engineers.

**

• Think beyond the code: Understand our strategy, goals and customer needs to enhance SimCorp’s impact.

• You will work closely with experienced engineers who support your development. Over time, you will grow into taking ownership of larger components and may mentor more junior colleagues as your experience grows.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• Solid knowledge of C#, .NET Core/Framework, and object-oriented design principles.

• Experience with APIs.

• Familiarity with modern engineering practices, including CI/CD pipelines and trunk-based development. We use Git (Azure DevOps).

• Interest in cloud engineering. We use Microsoft Azure.

• You understand the importance of automated testing of business‑critical functionality and quality assurance practices.

• Willingness to dive into a complex domain, working with finance, investment performance & attribution and investment-related instruments.

• You are able to solve complex problems in a structured manner.

• You are enthusiastic about building state-of-the-art software, and have the mindset needed to make others understand your ideas.

• Curiosity and adaptability to learn in-house tools and frameworks - including the APL programming language (no prior experience in APL required, we provide extensive training).

• You are good at coordinating with both programmers and non-programmers, to ensure a full understanding of tasks.

• You have a Master’s degree or higher within Computer Sciences, Engineering, Finance, Physics, Mathematics, Economics or similar experience.

• If you have knowledge of a financial domain it is plus, otherwise we will bring you up to speed using technical discussions, training and a comprehensive onboarding program.

**What Is It Like To Work Here

**SimCorp plans work in an agile manner, using 4 planning intervals (PI’s) per year, each consisting of 5 sprints of 2 weeks each, followed by a 3-week Innovation and Planning sprint, which can be used for mastering skills in various areas, or more freely investigating ideas with prototypes. It is important that our people learn and grow constantly, and SimCorp invests a lot to foster the continuous learning environment to support people on their journeys.

**Benefits

**Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide an excellent work & life balance: flexible work hours, a hybrid workplace model. On top of that, we have IP sprints where you have 3 weeks per quarter you can spend on mastering your skills as well as contributing to the company development. There is never just only one route - we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

**Job Description

**Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping companies turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in dynamic environments, working with some of the most complex and modern data solutions on the market? Are you ready to take ownership of shaping data architecture? If so, you might be our next colleague.

In Data Management, you join a team that enables our customers to develop and manage their business based on data and knowledge.

Data is at the core of everything we do, and our analyses, advice, and solutions consistently create real value for our customers. To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data management. You will work with a broad range of market-leading technologies, including Fabric, Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, Spark, Kafka, Dagster, Airflow, Terraform and others.

**Responsibilites

**

**About You

Through your professional experience, you have gained deep technical expertise and a structured, logical approach to solving complex data challenges. As a Senior Data Architect, you are comfortable stepping into a leadership role guiding both people and the technical direction, and you thrive in a collaborative, development-oriented environment with a focus on continuous learning.

To succeed in this role, you have significant experience with:

• Designing and implementing data solutions, including data modelling, ETL/ELT, and data warehousing.

• Multiple languages and technologies such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R, as well as Fabric, Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, Databricks, Dagster, Terraform and others.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

Lead engineering at a profitable, funded proptech while the team is still small enough to shape.

• Want to set the technical direction for a growing team and still ship code yourself?

• How would you keep a small team shipping to production many times a day, with review and testing that catch problems before customers do, without every decision landing on your desk?

• Where would you draw the line between what an AI agent should suggest and what it can do on a property owner’s behalf?

Sounds like you? Then you might be our next CTO!

A property owner with a portfolio of buildings has a practical question: which repairs belong in next year’s budget, and which can wait?

At Proprty.ai, our models estimate the condition and remaining life of building components and the energy and CO2 effect of improving them. Our software turns those estimates into maintenance plans, and our AI agent, Tily, helps owners analyze their portfolios and take action!

Our product went live in 2024 and is used by customers in Denmark, Norway and Germany. We reached profitability by the end of 2025 and raised DKK 21 million in April 2026, and we are not planning to stop there!

There is still so much we can do to make it even better, and you could help shape the future of building maintenance and how engineering is run at Proprty.ai.

Product: TypeScript, React and Next.js on Vercel, with Supabase (PostgreSQL, row-level security, storage).

Data and models: Python and PySpark on Databricks (Azure, EU), Python model services, and LLM features on Azure OpenAI. We also run a customer API and an MCP server.

What you get to shape

The team and the code.

You'll lead our product engineering team, work closely with our data engineers and our Chief Data Science Officer, and keep building core features yourself.

You might coach a developer through a tricky problem in the morning and ship a feature yourself that afternoon. You'll own engineering hiring as the team grows, from deciding which roles we need to choosing the people you want on the team.

How we build and ship.

You’ll own the platform’s architecture and how we test and release. We release to production many times a day. Your job is to keep that pace while making every release reliable and secure.

When an urgent customer request competes with longer-term platform work, you’ll make the call and explain what comes first and why.

Shape what Tily can do next.

Our data scientists build models for building condition, remaining life, cost, and energy across several European markets.

Together with our Chief Data Science Officer, you'll get those models in front of customers, decide what Tily may do on an owner's behalf, and use feedback from property owners, Sales, and Customer Success to choose the next problems to solve.

Change how we use AI ourselves.

Change how we use AI ourselves. Our engineers build with Claude Code and Cursor, AI agents review every pull request in our CI/CD pipeline, and agents take on routine work end to end so the team can ship faster.

We keep looking for new ways AI can raise our pace, and you'll lead that.

We talk a lot (in a good way). When a problem gets tricky, we pull up a chair and pair on it. We like having a laugh while we figure things out.

What you’ll bring?

You've been CTO or head of engineering at a startup or scale-up while the product, the team, and the rules were still taking shape, and you can show what changed because you were there.

You know when to open a pull request yourself, when to let another engineer make the call, and which shortcut will come back to bite you two releases from now.

You bring curiosity about our industry, our customers' problems, and the business acumen to understand how our product delivers business value, so that you can help facilitate features that drive outcomes and make our users' lives easier.

We’re AI-first (the name’s a bit of a giveaway). If you’ve built an agent or shipped an AI feature, we’d love to hear what happened after the demo. What did customers trust it to do, and where did they want the controls back? You’ll get to make those calls with Tily and figure out where AI helps our own engineers ship better software.

The core of what we consider for a candidate

• You’ve led an engineering team, coached developers, and hired people to join it.

• You’re keen to build AI agents that customers can put to work and to explore where AI makes your own team more effective.

• You still build full-stack features with React, TypeScript, and SQL. You can take a feature from technical design through thoughtful user experience to release, and measure what happens when customers get their hands on it.

• Fluent in English

Experience we’d love to hear about

• Taking an engineering team from a startup to a scale-up phase, understanding how and when to mature processes as the team scales, and how that looks different in this new AI era.

• Shipping an AI agent or feature into production. We’re especially curious about what you changed after people started using it.

• How you’ve spoken with customers and industry experts to help ensure we’re on the forefront of solving the right problems in our platform

• Your perspective on the role of a CTO as a thought leader.

• Working with PostgreSQL or Next.js, or building products for real estate or proptech.

Where we work

We spend 4 days a week together in our office near Rådhuspladsen. You’ll need to be based in the Copenhagen area, as we can’t offer relocation or visa sponsorship for this role.

New to proptech? That’s fine. If you’ve led engineers and still enjoy being one, we’d love to hear from you.

Questions? Reach out to Casper høgh at Csh@ing.dk, who helps us land the right human for the job

Our hiring process

• Intro call with Casper Høgh – We’ll talk about your background, what you want from your next CTO role, and any questions you have about proprty.ai.

• In-person interview – Meet us at our Copenhagen office for a small demo and talk through the team, the decisions you’d own, and how you like to lead while staying hands-on.

• Case interview – Work through an engineering scenario with us. We want to understand what you’d prioritize, which trade-offs you see, and why.

• Board interview - Meet with one of our board members. Get their perspective on our journey and talk them through how you would help us in our next phase of growth.

• Offer – If we both see a fit, we’ll talk through the offer and next steps together.

TL;DR

Want to get in early with a great team? Love leading engineers and still writing code?

Apply now to lead our dev team and make building maintenance smarter and more sustainable with AI.

The position

• Finnish Market: Responsible for growing EasyTable's customer base in Finland.

Both positions are focused on proactive sales, where you will manage your own pipeline and work towards clear individual targets.

Send your CV and application here or to the email provided under contact information.

If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges, driving product development, and creating value across the entire product lifecycle, you could be our next Senior Development Engineer.

****Meet your future team
